# Primeagent Documentation

> Official documentation for Primeagent, a low-code platform for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows with a visual builder, API, and MCP server. Technical documentation for developers, data scientists, and teams building RAG and multi-agent applications.

Primeagent is open source (MIT). Run locally with `uv run primeagent run` (Python 3.10–3.14, default http://127.0.0.1:7860). Also available as Primeagent Desktop (Windows, macOS). Key areas: get started (installation, quickstart, tutorials), flows (build, run via API or webhooks, test, import/export), agents and MCP, develop (config, storage, observability), deploy (Docker, Kubernetes, cloud), components reference, and API reference.

## Docs

- [About Primeagent](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/about-primeagent): Platform overview and introduction
- [Install Primeagent](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/get-started-installation): Installation options (OSS, Docker, from source)
- [Quickstart](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/get-started-quickstart): Get up and running quickly
- [Use the visual editor](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/concepts-overview): Visual flow builder overview
- [Trigger flows with the API](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/concepts-publish): Run flows via the Primeagent API
- [Agents](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/agents): Agents and tools
- [MCP client and server](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/mcp-client): Model Context Protocol integration
- [Deployment overview](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/deployment-overview): How to deploy Primeagent
- [Security](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/security): Deployment and security guidance
- [Release notes](https://docs.prime.khulnasoft.com/release-notes): Version history and release notes
